grammarSemantics.@name: Reference definitions[name] only. No checker namespace is available.
grammarSemantics.record: All named fields mandatory, no extra keys, exact native JSON types, keys order-insensitive. Empty record closed too.
grammarSemantics.enum: Typed exact one listed scalar. literal: deep typed equality to listed JSON value.
grammarSemantics.union: At least one alternative; null only where explicit null branch.
grammarSemantics.integer: Inclusive safe native integer range; JSON tokens no fraction/exponent/-0/coercion.
grammarSemantics.stringMax: Maximum UTF8 bytes; string must contain valid Unicode scalar values. Optional anchored pattern uses existing ECMAScript regexp semantics; no normalization. Pattern-only string also <=131072 UTF8 bytes.
grammarSemantics.boolean/null: Exact native JSON type, never string.
grammarSemantics.tuple: Exactly listed length and per-position element grammars; no rest items.
grammarSemantics.beforeParse: Duplicate decoded keys rejected at every nesting before object construction; bound raw input bytes before parse.
grammarSemantics.all: Closed schemas describe data shape only. Actual owned raw/native authentication, private same-module identities, current integrity, exact selected cell and no-call joins are mandatory; schema match never creates authority.
grammarSemantics.literal: Deep typed exact equality to the listed data, no subset/prefix matching or coercion. Checker native literals include the entire native13-key object.

byteRules.strict: Strict UTF8/scalars/decoded duplicate-key rejection, safe integer tokens, no BOM/repair/coercion. Exactly one terminal LF per message. Bounds checked before parse.
byteRules.largeEvidence: Opaque source/binary/evidence hashes use bounded streaming descriptor checks, not the32MiB raw parser. Verified inventory <=2048files/512MiB each/4GiB total; pin first expected descriptor, reject conflicting later pin; final recheck.
byteRules.ownedFiles: Fresh0700 dirs/0600 regular files; no overwrite/symlink/alias; absolute canonical paths.

shapeOnlyNotice: Native shape definitions retain full nested keys/types/array arity/null branches, not expected plaintext/rumor IDs/content. Actual scalar authentication/association/status semantics come from fixed source checks, not supplied expectations.
ownership: Only actual owned ChildProcess/pipe/raw span and private same-new-module handles authorize source-local facts. JSON/descriptors/flags alone are not handles. No N generation/reservation exists.
